CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2645 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head ad62bf6346a131111ea482185caa2813e9851a19. Bus nonce: da7eafe36d7cad6ecc675da0f5632b30. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin ad62bf6346a131111ea482185caa2813e9851a19`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge ad62bf6346a131111ea482185caa2813e9851a19` or `Fix review: blocked ad62bf6346a131111ea482185caa2813e9851a19 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: da7eafe36d7cad6ecc675da0f5632b30`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2645 ad62bf6346a131111ea482185caa2813e9851a19") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2645-da7eafe3`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, PR #2645 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), R10-FLOW-TOOLKIT-MEASURE: the flow study's measuring instruments (ci_critpath.py, flow_metrics.py, review_strength.py) generalised for any round. Head ad62bf6346a131111ea482185caa2813e9851a19. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Check:
1. No round constant in code: repository, roster, group prefix and window are arguments. Grep the three instruments for hard-coded r10/R10 or this repo's name outside defaults the body names.
2. Self-tests: ci_critpath 24/0, flow_metrics 16/0, review_strength 100/0; selftest_wiring --check reports 89 wired. Run the four named mutants (ci_critpath-1/-2, flow_metrics-1/-2) plus your own; each must turn its self-test red. The conflict resolution kept main's ruleset_cutover-1..3 mutants in dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py intact: diff that file three-dot against origin/main and confirm main's block is byte-identical.
3. The fixer did not re-run the full mutant harness after the last merge (hours on a Mac). Judge whether the named set covers what changed; if a changed site has no mutant, that is a finding.
4. tests/structure.py passes; Architecture score dS +0.0000; merges clean with origin/main (git merge-tree --write-tree). The fixer saw 4 entity failures on a Mac (heartbeat timing, a8:register_once) that also fail on main, and pr_args.sh --self-test 93/4 on main on the Mac: say what CI at the head shows.
5. Carries: carry_audit (tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2645) reads 5 routed, 0 unrouted, 0 bad (body sha1 1e5c131a). Three were re-homed off the absorbed R10-ORCH-MACHINERY to R10-FLY-YIELD-GUARD, R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2 and R10-FLOW-JIDOKA (handoff/audit-r10-roster at 2ad8710e4); judge each destination as the right owner.
6. Read CI at the head from check-runs (one bulk read); answer every red in ## Red checks. Spare the API.

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
